نتشابه (form VI)
# نَتَشَابَهُ (natašābahu) /na.ta.ʃaː.ba.hu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَابَهَ (tašābaha)
# نَتَشَابَهَ (natašābaha) /na.ta.ʃaː.ba.ha/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَابَهَ (tašābaha)
# نَتَشَابَهْ (natašābah) /na.ta.ʃaː.bah/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَابَهَ (tašābaha)
